Examples.Title: Upload a file to the server
Examples.Description:
Uploads a file, up to 10 GB. Other endpoints call it the source file.

Use the `id` from the response as `source_id` to start tasks. One file can start several tasks.
The file is deleted at the `expires` time from the response.
Examples.Code:
### Upload a file to the server
# @name upload_upload
POST {{host}}/api/v1/upload/
X-License-Key: {{api_key}}
Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=song.mp3
Content-Type: application/octet-stream
Accept: application/json

< ./request.bin
